protocol: All reference exports use English. Answer in the requested language without retrieving translated copies.
Select all relevant sections, then topics, catalog pages and text parts; never load bulk mirrors by default.
Catalog records contain exact IDs, summaries, questions, keywords, relations, sectionSources and ordered text parts. A file can contain several articles; select by ID.

Parts are lossless source excerpts between llm:body / llm:end markers. Concatenate in part order without the marker newlines to recover a complete article. Follow remaining parts before drawing conclusions about a command.
Resolve relative links in a body against its canonical article URL. Follow cross-section links when a task spans scripting, plugins and resources.

Use the symbol index for exact commands/events/functions and the resource index for filenames. Resolve sourceRefs / sectionSources through sources. State version limits and distinguish source review from in-game execution.
Cite canonical article URLs and anchors in answers. If retrieval is unavailable, request the specific linked files; do not pretend the reference was read.
